item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description: New in 2.5.0: a full texture upgrade across the savanna. Every animal now wears a detailed 2048px coat (fur, scales, feathers, shell and hide), and the world gained real textures for rock, crate wood, acacia bark and leaves, barrels, canyon walls, waterhole mud and grass, with subtle detail maps on High and Ultra. The 2.4.0 work is all here too: the graphics boost on stronger Macs (Ultra renders at 1800x1125 with 8x MSAA), power-ups that land properly (Mud Bath overheals into a visible shield, timed effects last 18 seconds with an on-screen countdown, a guaranteed marked pickup every wave, drafted boons shown on the HUD), much harder bosses with a bite that hits at 1.75x, predators that visibly bite down (jaws open on the wind-up and slam shut on the damage frame, and a bite only lands when the head reaches you), full gamepad support (wired and Bluetooth) with twin-stick aim, mouse-look in third person, first-person view waiting at Prestige Tier 4, and the story crossfade fix. Updating also changed: the game now asks before it installs anything, you can scan for updates yourself in Settings, and Settings can also go back one version if an update does not suit you.
